difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the underlying topological space of a Zariski locally quasi-separated algebraic space is sober (statement lines 2079-2084). The proof (proof lines 2086-2125) reduces to a single affine etale chart and applies the finite fibre Kolmogorov criterion, then for an irreducible closed subset produces a closed subspace with an open dense subscheme and uses soberness of schemes to obtain a generic point. H3: a two-stage reduction with a genuine use of the scheme case on a dense subscheme, written out in full.
